title: Distinct Signatures of Dynamical and Spectral Criticality in Quenched Quantum Batteries
summary: Criticality is widely used to enhance energy storage in quantum batteries. Two criticalities are compared here, one spectral and one dynamical. We ask two questions. Where does the enhancement that criticality brings to a quenched battery come from? And does the best charging performance require a critical point or a critical time? In the anisotropic XY chain, whose dynamics decomposes into independent momentum sectors, the weight each sector transfers to its upper level organizes the response.
